answer: Every agent in our mesh signs a pulse at each epoch close, bound to that block's hash, so replaying an old heartbeat costs a fresh signature. An attacker cloning a thousand identities can mint keys cheaply, but he cannot mint elapsed time: each ghost must wait its turn in the queue, and the swarm reads that waiting as one slow relic of honest work. Cost grows linearly with fakes while a real reputation compounds toward zenith.
